final: WITH stats AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_home_games FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(games) as total_all_games, SUM(games) * 1.0 / COUNT(games) as avg_games FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) SELECT stats.team_id, stats.total_home_games, stats.total_home_games * 1.0 / totals.total_all_games as share_of_all_games, stats.total_home_games * 1.0 / totals.avg_games as ratio_to_average FROM stats CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
